name: My Lust Academy: PoS
source: The player takes the role of a young prostitute who makes a living doing what he likes most. However, his life would take a 360-degree turn when he would end up being discovered by a professional heroine, which would change his life completely.
translation: 玩家扮演一名年轻妓女，靠做自己最喜欢的事情谋生。然而，当他被一个职业女主角发现时，他的生活发生了360度的大转变，彻底改变了他的生活。
